title: Data Foundations and Spreadsheets
prerequisites: Read short English instructions with teacher support
Use a mouse and keyboard on a school computer
Recognize numbers and simple categories in a table
objectives: Find the title, column names, rows, and cells in a data table
Correct common data-quality and formatting problems
Use SUM and AVERAGE formulas in a guided spreadsheet example
Identify common chart types and the parts of a column chart
Build and label one column chart
Answer questions and write a conclusion that matches chart evidence
evidence: Immutable local attempt history with datasets, responses, scores, and editing snapshots
Downloadable HTML practice report that reconstructs the student's saved tables, formulas, charts, and written responses

requirements.device: School computer or laptop; pairs may share one device
requirements.software: Modern web browser; spreadsheet software is needed only for the separate class assignment
requirements.internet: Required for first load unless the module was cached or copied locally

knownRisks: Progress is saved only in the current browser and device
Shared school computers require students to export their report and reset progress before the next user
The module needs a monitored Grade 6 pilot before ready status
The public practice module does not replace formal assessment directions or rubrics
planningUse: Prototype only. Pilot with the printable fallback and keep Summative Activities #1, #2, and #5 outside the module.
